item.title: Open burning season starts January 15th
item.description: DENNIS – Open Burn Permits are now available online through our OpenGov online permitting portal. Open Burning is allowed January 15 to May 1 of each year. item.title: No injuries after car, dump truck collide on Route 6 in Eastham
item.description: EASTHAM – A car and dump truck collided on Route 6 in Eastham about 4 PM Friday. The crash happened on State Highway (Route 6A in front of the Fire Station near Samoset Road. Luckily no injuries were reported. Traffic delays were reported in the area. Eastham Police are investigating the cause of the crash.
